# ZH Homes

> ZH Homes is a home remodeling and construction company serving Salem, Keizer, and nearby Oregon communities. Always confirm service availability, pricing, and timelines with the business.

## Site pages
- [ZH Homes homepage](https://www.zhhomeco.com/): Company overview, services, project examples, and contact.
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://www.zhhomeco.com/bathroomremodel.html): Bathroom remodeling services and projects.
- [Bathroom remodel landing page](https://www.zhhomeco.com/bathroom-remodel.html): Remodels and shower conversions.
- [Bathroom estimate request](https://www.zhhomeco.com/quote.html): Multi-step form for a free bathroom estimate.
- [Deck projects](https://www.zhhomeco.com/decks.html): Deck construction and related services.
